gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-odor-mean-chey: Expressive and wiry, Funnel Display draws every line the same width. Odor Mean Chey follows with pinched, tall rounded serif letters that make a long page feel dense and bookish.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-pt-serif-captio: PT Serif Caption reads tall and literary, with thin joins where curves meet stems, and modest thick-thin contrast. Funnel Display is best at wirelike, uniform drama; the serif is best at carrying text.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-suez-one: Funnel Display traces its round letters with no tilt in the stress, while Suez One brings big, open-looking bowls and thin channels. Bigger headings will let that wire line breathe.
gen-gf-funnel-display-lora: A constant-width line, like something etched by laser, defines Funnel Display and gives it a commanding look. Lora then thins gently at its curves, so a long stretch of text feels bookish and warm.
gen-gf-funnel-display-merriweather: Funnel Display's plain, unmodulated outline is the first thing you notice, with c tips that never drift together. And Merriweather's tall, stocky middle band with its soft thick-thin shift gives the pair its sturdy, cozy grip.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro sets a high mean line and strokes like bent steel rod, giving a clean sans-serif base. Fuzzy Bubbles earns its keep as a big, short heading, where its rounded, personal hand can show.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-bespoke-sans: A plain stripe of constant ink, rounded and drafting-pen steady, is what sets Fuzzy Bubbles apart from the start. Bespoke Sans sharpens the page below with generous gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-literata: Literata reads like a sturdy text serif, with firm thin lines, slightly heavier thick ones, and wide, unclosed curves. Over many paragraphs it feels sophisticated and bookish, against the handwritten heading's constant weight.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-merriweather-san: Every stroke of Fuzzy Bubbles has the same gauge, rounded and relaxed, with small letters nearly as tall as its capitals. Merriweather Sans does the sturdy work, its tall lowercase and open e making words look large.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-ranade: Fuzzy Bubbles writes with a marker-nib line that ignores direction, rounded and personal, nearly level in height between small letters and capitals. Ranade then adds a brush-like, slightly shifting sans line, spaced wide.
